# Identity / MFA

Primary sources:
- Microsoft Entra: https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/
- Duo Admin API: https://duo.com/docs/adminapi
- Okta developer/docs: https://developer.okta.com/docs/

Use for SAML, OIDC/OAuth, LDAP, MFA, sign-in logs, token/claim flows, role mapping, identity risk, and API integrations.

Separate:
authentication,
authorization,
role/group mapping,
session/token issuance,
application-side enforcement.
